passage:
Modern shoppers face an unprecedented variety of products. A single supermarket may offer dozens of brands of cereal, hundreds of types of beverages, and an overwhelming selection of household goods. While consumers often claim to enjoy having many options, psychological research suggests that too much choice can actually reduce satisfaction and increase anxiety.

This phenomenon, sometimes called 'choice overload,' was famously demonstrated in a study comparing two displays of jam in a grocery store. Shoppers were more likely to stop and taste at the display with 24 varieties, but those who saw only 6 varieties were ten times more likely to actually purchase a jar. Researchers concluded that too many options made consumers anxious about making the wrong decision, leading many to leave without buying anything.

Choice overload affects more than shopping. It can influence career decisions, healthcare choices, and even relationships. Some experts recommend that businesses and institutions simplify their offerings to help people decide more confidently. However, others argue that complete elimination of choice would limit personal freedom and innovation, suggesting that the best approach may be to provide guidance rather than restriction.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Having unlimited choices always benefits consumers.
options.B: Too many options can decrease satisfaction and lead to indecision.

questions.explanation_ar: الفكرة الرئيسية أن كثرة الخيارات تقلل الرضا وتزيد التردد.

questions.q: According to the passage, what did the jam study show?

options.A: Shoppers prefer to taste before buying.
options.B: More varieties attracted attention but fewer varieties led to more purchases.
options.C: Customers always buy the cheapest option.
options.D: Grocery stores make more money with bigger displays.

questions.explanation_ar: دراسة المربى أظهرت أن العرض الأكبر جذب الانتباه لكن العرض الأصغر أدى إلى شراء أكثر بعشر مرات.

questions.q: The word 'unprecedented' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation_ar: unprecedented = غير مسبوق/لم يحدث من قبل.

questions.q: What can be inferred about consumers facing many choices?

options.B: They may avoid making any decision at all.

questions.explanation_ar: النص يذكر أن المستهلكين أحياناً يغادرون دون شراء، مما يشير إلى تجنب القرار.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an area affected by choice overload?
questions.explanation_ar: النص يذكر العمل والصحة والعلاقات. التعليم لم يُذكر.
